design.name: 沙葬弩尸
design.brief: An undead Tang-dynasty frontier garrison crossbowman (戍卒) risen from the desert sands: a lanky, slightly hunched sun-bleached skeleton wearing the broken remains of Chinese lamellar armour (札甲) — a few rows of rusty bronze lamellae on the chest and one shoulder — over tattered sand-coloured burial cloth, a torn conical bamboo rain hat (斗笠) with a red tassel on top, a yellow Taoist paper talisman (符箓) with red brush strokes stuck on its forehead and fluttering, teal-green ghost-fire glowing in both eye sockets and a small teal-green ghost flame inside the visible ribcage, strings of old square-holed copper coins and white paper burial money tied at the waist, a crimson waist sash with the faction's gold cloud-scroll (祥云) emblem, a cylindrical lacquered quiver (箭箙) of bone bolts on its back. Bony hands with a clearly separate bony thumb and four long separate bony fingers each. Bony feet with five separate toe bones, partly wrapped in cloth.
design.weapon: a heavy Han-style Chinese crossbow with a bronze trigger mechanism (弩机) and a bone-and-wood stock carved with a dragon head
